context.title: DSA San Diego — November 3, 2026 California general election endorsements

of.name: Democratic Socialists of America, San Diego

subject.title: California Insurance Commissioner

positions.statement: Insurance Commissioner: Jane Kim

subject.title: California Superintendent of Public Instruction

positions.statement: State Superintendent of Public Instruction: NOT Sonja Shaw (see CA DSA Guide)

subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 51

positions.statement: We recommend a vote for Sara Jacobs.

subject.title: California State Assembly, District 79

positions.statement: The choice here is clear: we recommend a vote for LaShae Sharp-Collins.

subject.title: San Diego County Board of Supervisors, District 4

positions.statement: We recommend a vote for Monica Montgomery Steppe.

subject.title: San Diego County Board of Education, District 3

positions.statement: In solidarity with AFT Guild Local 1931, the chapter recommends voting for each of its endorsed members for county and community college district offices. Thus, we recommend a vote for Alicia Muñoz.

subject.title: San Diego County Board of Education, District 5

positions.statement: In solidarity with AFT Guild Local 1931, the chapter recommends voting for each of its endorsed members for county and community college district offices. Thus, we recommend a vote for Rick Shea.

subject.title: San Diego County — Measure A (A Transparent, Accountable, Modern County Government)

positions.statement: In an effort not to let the perfect be the enemy of the good, we recommend a Yes vote on Measure A.

subject.title: San Diego County — Measure B (Measure to Fund San Diego County Health & Safety Services)

positions.statement: We recommend a Yes vote on Measure B.

subject.title: San Diego City Council, District 2

positions.statement: All of that being said, we recommend Nicole Crosby for San Diego City Council, District 2.

subject.title: San Diego City Council, District 4

positions.statement: Foster is a progressive ally that we want to keep in City Council. We recommend voting for Henry Foster III.

subject.title: San Diego Community College District Board, District A

positions.statement: Thus, we recommend a vote for Maria Senour.

subject.title: San Diego Community College District Board, District C

positions.statement: Thus, we recommend a vote for Craig Milgrim.

subject.title: San Diego Unified School District Board, District C

positions.statement: We recommend Hayden Gore for SD Unified School District, District C.

subject.title: San Diego Unified School District — Measure M (San Diego Unified School District Repair, Student Safety, No Tax Rate Increase Measure)

positions.statement: We recommend a Yes vote on Measure M.

subject.title: Oceanside City Council, District 1

positions.statement: We recommend a vote for Eric Joyce for Oceanside City Council, District 1.

subject.title: Oceanside City Council, District 2

positions.statement: We believe Gonzales is the most viable challenge to Robinson and because of her strong labor backing, we recommend a vote for Emily Gonzales for Oceanside City Council, District 2.

subject.title: Tri-City Healthcare District Board, Zone 2

positions.statement: We recommend Kayla Lauriano.

subject.title: Oceanside — Measure R (Oceanside Charter — Prevailing Wage & Fair Competition Measure)

positions.statement: We recommend a Yes vote on Measure R.

subject.title: Oceanside — Measure S (Oceanside Local Services & Infrastructure Sales Tax Measure)

positions.statement: We therefore recommend a Yes vote on Measure S.

subject.title: Vista Mayor

positions.statement: We proudly endorse Kenneth Zuniga for Mayor of Vista.

positions.statement: We recommend Corinna Contreras.

subject.title: Vista Unified School District — Measure N (Vista Unified School District School Improvement Bond of 2026)

positions.statement: We recommend a Yes vote on Measure N.

subject.title: Escondido Mayor

subject.title: Escondido City Council, District 1

positions.statement: We recommend Vanessa Valenzuela.

subject.title: Escondido City Council, District 2

positions.statement: We recommend Anthony Dimartino.

subject.title: El Cajon Mayor

positions.statement: We wholeheartedly endorse Alexander Kraft for Mayor of El Cajon.

subject.title: Grossmont Union High School District Board, Trustee Area 3

positions.statement: As Woods has been complicit if not a driving force behind many of the board’s controversies, we recommend Jenne Littrell.

subject.title: Grossmont Union High School District Board, Trustee Area 4

positions.statement: We trust the teacher’s union endorsement and positions Mull has taken as enough reason to recommend Steve Mull.

subject.title: Grossmont Union High School District Board, Trustee Area 5

positions.statement: We recommend Pete Mergens.

subject.title: Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District Board, Trustee Area 5

positions.statement: Thus, we recommend a vote for Mary Gwin.

subject.title: Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District — Measure G (Fire Safety, Job Training, College Affordability, No Tax Rate Increase Measure)

positions.statement: We recommend a Yes vote on Measure G.

subject.title: Imperial Beach Mayor

positions.statement: Due to his strong connection to labor and his experience in city government, we recommend Matthew Lebya-Gonzalez for Imperial Beach Mayor.

subject.title: Imperial Beach City Council, District 1

positions.statement: Lopez Eguino has demonstrated himself as the only candidate worth supporting in D1, therefore we recommend Jose Lopez Eguino for IB D1.
